# Bootstrap card

Requirements: any C11 compiler (gcc, clang, MinGW, MSVC-compatible); the build workflow also needs a POSIX shell (sh, MSYS2 or Git Bash on Windows). No installed NanoC, packages or downloads.

```sh
cc -std=c11 -O2 build.c -o builder
./builder bootstrap
./build/nanoc --version
./builder test
CC=clang ./builder test --sanitize
```

| Stage | Built from | Emits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `build/stage0` | Frozen `bootstrap/src` C + `bootstrap/include` | `build/stage1/src` C |
| `build/stage1-nanoc` | Stage 1 C, generated from `src` NanoC | `build/stage2/src` C |
| `build/nanoc` | Stage 2 C, generated by self-hosted NanoC | `build/stage3/src` C |

Every module's stage 1, 2 and 3 emitted C must match byte for byte. `build` caches verified builds by source/header/seed contents, compiler and sanitizer mode. `bootstrap` forces the complete chain. `clean` removes all stages.

```sh
./builder snapshot    # verify, then regenerate the committed C seed + frozen headers
./builder bootstrap   # prove the regenerated seed builds the same compiler
```

Seed C is generated and frozen; do not maintain a second implementation. Compiler modules under src stay at most 200 physical lines.
